Separate normally-open service pushbutton; not a matrix position. Factory Figure 3 locates S33 on the MPU. The adjustment instructions use it to clear the selected bookkeeping/high-game value. This record represents that one physical service button, separate from coin-door self test; it does not promise an unconditional bookkeeping-clear API.

mechanisms.behavior: Three independently latched targets. A hit closes its contact until this bank's common reset coil raises it and opens its contacts. Factory and retained script give the target order. The ROM resets both banks on startup; both reset outputs fire when either bank is completed in the retained gameplay sequence. The factory rules and S24 determine later triple-bonus completion conditions. No numeric mechanical timing or modeled jam sensor is established.
mechanisms.label: Left drop bank

Factory and retained script give the target order. The ROM resets both banks on startup; both reset outputs fire when either bank is completed in the retained gameplay sequence. The factory rules and S24 determine later triple-bonus completion conditions. No numeric mechanical timing or modeled jam sensor is established.
mechanisms.label: Upper right drop bank

mechanisms.behavior: One ball drains onto the outhole contact, bonus is counted and the kicker feeds the manual shooter lane. The host releases 8 when the ball leaves. BallRelease is a shooter proxy; this is not a multiball trough.
mechanisms.label: Outhole and shooter feed

mechanisms.behavior: Ball closes switch 38; ROM fires coil 13. Physical ring/skirt mechanism returns mechanically.
mechanisms.label: Thumper bumper

mechanisms.behavior: Rubber hit closes 37; ROM fires coil 15. Local tables' opposite switch write is a defect.
mechanisms.label: Left slingshot

mechanisms.behavior: Rubber hit closes 36; ROM fires coil 14. Local tables' opposite switch write is a defect.
mechanisms.label: Right slingshot

mechanisms.behavior: Passive spinning target, one closure per contact actuation. No motor or home sensor.
mechanisms.label: Left spinner

mechanisms.behavior: Passive spinning target, one closure per contact actuation. No motor or home sensor.
mechanisms.label: Right spinner

mechanisms.behavior: Player-powered shooter serves one ball. No launch coil or shooter-lane switch is listed; strength is table-owned.
mechanisms.label: Manual plunger

mechanisms.behavior: Four electromechanical chime coils for 10, 100, 1000 and 10000. The fourth is EXTRA CHIME on the schematic. No electronic sound board or feedback switch.
mechanisms.label: Chime unit

mechanisms.behavior: Cabinet button and enable relay switch a dual-winding flipper. Normally-closed EOS bypass opens near full stroke. Synthetic 47/48 do not simulate real EOS or winding timing.
mechanisms.label: Left flipper

mechanisms.behavior: Cabinet button and enable relay switch a dual-winding flipper. Normally-closed EOS bypass opens near full stroke. Synthetic 45/46 do not simulate real EOS or winding timing.
mechanisms.label: Right flipper
